description:
Import duty rates for a product code (PAID - REQUIRES PAYMENT).

    Coverage: us (HTS 10-digit, current), gb (UK Global Tariff CN10, current),
    jp (Japan Customs CN9, current), and ca/eu/th/vn/id/my/ph/sg/mx/cn/kr as a
    HS6 HISTORICAL-COMPARATIVE tier (TRAINS 2023) - the payload says which.

    Args:
        hs: product code, 6-10 digits, e.g. "610910" for T-shirts
        jurisdiction: two-letter code, default us
        limit: max rows, 1-100

    Payment: 1 XRP (XRPL, x_payment_signature + x_inv_id), or USDC on
    Base (x_base_tx) / Solana (x_sol_payload). Call unpaid to receive the quote.
name: xrplme_customs
